mission: Editorial assembly + QA + export + final-acceptance spec for F11. Non-billed spec; nothing rendered/exported yet.

editorialAssembly.order: assemble accepted shots per the F11 shot-list order → dialogue/VO → music (CC0) → SFX/ambience (CC0) → mix → titles/credits → export
editorialAssembly.pacing: action set-pieces carry 64%; relief/comedy beats between set-pieces; drama spine at the 5 kept scenes; no two mass-VFX shots back-to-back
editorialAssembly.continuity: apply the visual-bible invariants + sound-raccord (crossfade/J-L at ambience boundaries)
editorialAssembly.distributionMeasurement: AFTER the edit exists, MEASURE realized action/story/tension/drama/comedy/world screen-time on the rendered timeline vs 64/13/10/5/5/3 — this is the DEFINITION-OF-DONE check (not the estimate).

automatable: CIQE: no black frames, flicker/temporal-pop in bounds, stream integrity
audio: present, no clipping, levels, sync-markers
human_required: character identity consistency vs approved refs across motion
qaGates.rule: A technically green QA pass is NOT final acceptance — human cinematic review is mandatory. Reject on any identity/continuity/anachronism breach regardless of polish.

export.master: 1080p+ (deliverable CONTRACT), H.264/H.265, stated frame rate, loudness-normalized mix
export.captions: generate SRT subtitles (EN master; FR/ES derive later)
export.credits: cast/crew + AUDIO ASSET CREDITS + per-file license evidence (even CC0 — record provenance)
export.deliveryPackage: master video + subtitles + audio-asset license ledger + shot manifest (sha256) + edit manifest (reproducible)

finalAcceptanceCriteria: all required sequences GENERATED and human-ACCEPTED
realized distribution MEASURED on the rendered timeline (≈64/13/10/5/5/3, within a stated tolerance)
QA gates pass (automatable) + human cinematic review ≥ bar
status: SPEC READY. None of the acceptance criteria are met yet — nothing is rendered, assembled, or exported. The film is NOT finished.
